title: Quality Roasted British Chicken Sunday Roast
description: A classic British dish featuring roasted chicken, fennel, and leafy greens, perfect for a family Sunday roast. This recipe is high in protein and kid-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 degrees Celsius.
Rinse the chicken and pat it dry with paper towels.
Season the chicken with salt, pepper, and olive oil.
Stuff the chicken cavity with chopped onion, garlic, and fennel.
Place the chicken in a roasting pan and put it in the oven.
Roast the chicken for 30 minutes, then reduce the heat to 180 degrees Celsius.
Add the chopped carrots, potatoes, and brussels sprouts to the roasting pan.
Toss the vegetables in olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Return the pan to the oven and roast for an additional 45 minutes.
Remove the pan from the oven and let the chicken rest for 10 minutes.
Serve the chicken with the roasted vegetables and steamed leafy greens.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
